methodology: Three additional fresh sequential native Windows processes, 1/10/30 MiB single tabs; same environment and cadence as the six-run matrix, trace off, normal drafts, active/exposed checks. Original matrix remains unchanged. Raw samples and phase distributions retained; four metric quantiles independently recalculated.

runs.method: Native exposed MainWindow, standard app bindings, independent producer posts synthetic Qt keyboard/wheel/tab/action events at fixed cadence. Paint means completed QWidget paint dispatch, not DWM/display presentation. Nearest-rank quantiles; raw samples included. 8ms GUI heartbeat and 20ms working-set sampler. Isolated settings/files; autosave and update checks disabled; normal recovery-draft timers retained.
